symptoms.label: Fare rises after route changes
symptoms.root_cause: Trips become longer through deliberate detours, navigation errors, incorrect GPS guidance, convenience routes, traffic, or recalculation of actual route and duration. Improve route guidance, review driver deviations, protect customers from fare increases caused by driver errors, and explain adjustments before collection.

symptoms.label: Unexpected trip surcharges
symptoms.root_cause: Customers see added fees after personal stops, toll use, or wait charges that do not match their pickup experience. Validate toll and stop charges, require consent for optional detours, and check pickup arrival and wait records before applying fees.

symptoms.label: Paid rides leave account balances
symptoms.root_cause: An open trip, a cash payment recorded as unpaid, or a duplicate fare adjustment can leave a balance after the customer believes the ride is settled. Close trips at the actual drop-off, reconcile driver-reported payments, and remove duplicate or unrelated balances.

dropped_causes.label: Passenger changes destination mid-trip
dropped_causes.description: The passenger corrects or changes the destination after pickup, so the route and fare differ from the originally quoted trip.
